reason: It says halal-certified but doesn't say who certified it, and that's the first thing I check before anything else. On top of that I'm not convinced collagen does more for my joints than the protein I already eat, so £18 on a maybe isn't happening this week.
objection: Which certifying body? 'Halal-certified' with no name could mean anything, and with bovine products I need to know exactly who signed off on the slaughter and the processing.
would_change_my_mind: The certifying body named on the pouch and site (one I recognise, like HMC), plus a cousin in the WhatsApp group saying it actually helped her knees after a couple of months.
